The input medical image enters the segmentation framework.
A downsampler reduces the spatial dimensions before feature extraction.
The frozen Transformer backbone processes the visual tokens.
Overview of the transformer block container.
First column of transformer layers.
Second column of transformer layers.
Third column of transformer layers.
Fourth column of transformer layers.
Trainable low-rank adaptation bypasses adapt the encoder parameters efficiently.
The encoder outputs a sequence of extracted image embeddings.
In the first stage, the initial Transformer decoder processes these embeddings.
Transformer decoder module container.
Self-attention evaluates the importance of different regions.
Cross-attention aligns the queries with the image embeddings.
In parallel, the stage-one pixel decoder upsamples spatial features.
The outputs of both decoders are multiplied together.
This generates an intermediate, quarter-resolution probabilistic prior mask.

text.tspan: The Class-Balanced Mask-Guided Self-Attention block uses the prior mask
to balance head and tail classes.

g.text: This produces enriched image embeddings for the next decoding stage.
The stage-two Transformer decoder carries out refined mask decoding.
Second transformer decoder container.

text.tspan: Learnable mask cross-attention spatially modulates attention across regions

g.text: Self-attention further refines the object queries.

text.tspan: The hierarchical pixel decoder integrates skip connections from stage one

g.text: The refined queries and high-resolution pixel features are combined.
Finally, the framework produces the high-resolution multi-organ segmentation prediction.
